caption:
Nintendo just made up a brand new holiday called Pikmin Day because why not. 🌿 Now we have cute little plant creatures taking over our feeds and actual new game updates to keep us busy. Are you ready to celebrate, or is this just another excuse to buy merch? 👇

@nintendoamerica

Source: The Verge

#Nintendo #Pikmin #GamingNews #GenZCulture #MarketingStrategy

post.news: Nintendo just declared November 1st as the first annual Pikmin Day, complete with a new Switch 2 game mode and animated shorts.
post.take: Nintendo really looked at tiny plant creatures and decided they deserved a national holiday before most of us.
post.insight: Brands don't need a massive product launch to create a new holiday; sometimes you just invent an annual day and let superfans do the rest.
